title: Low degree learner sample count
statement: For nonnegative integers $n$ and $\ell$ and a rational parameter $\delta$ with $0<\delta\le 1/2$, the scheduled low degree polynomial learner's sample count is $2^\ell\bigl(M(n,\ell)+\lceil\log_2\lceil 2/\delta\rceil\rceil\bigr)$, where $M(n,\ell)$ is the number of subsets of an $n$-element set having cardinality at most $\ell$.
